lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Fix the existing required consent gate and unreadable dark cards while retaining the authoritative server acceptance contract.

preserveBehaviors: No backend migration, RLS changes, auth bypass, new permissions, native additions or changes to ad/tab navigation.
